restaurant.subtitle: Kayan dafa abinci na zamani & kamfani mai kyau

burrata.name: Burrata & tumatur na gado
burrata.short: Burrata mai tsami, cikakke tumatir, gasasshen tsami.
burrata.description: Kwallo mai laushi na burrata mai laushi, tumatur na gado mai dadi da basil, an gama da man zaitun. Ki kwashe shi da gasasshen tsami mai dumi.
burrata.ingredients: Burrata (madara), tumatir, Basil, man zaitun, tsami (alkama), gishirin teku.

dumplings.name: Chili - dumplings
dumplings.short: Gwanin kayan lambu na zinariya, man barkono, scallions.
dumplings.description: Dumplings ɗin kayan lambu guda shida masu kwanon rufi tare da ƙwanƙolin gindi da wuri mai laushi. An gama da man barkono da scallions, tare da tsoma miya a gefe.
dumplings.ingredients: Rubutun alkama, kabeji, namomin kaza, karas, scallions, soya sauce (soya, alkama), sesame, man chili.

pasta.name: Tumatir & Basil rigatoni
pasta.short: Tumatir da aka gasa a hankali, basil sabo, parmesan.
pasta.description: Tumatir da aka kakkaɓe an jefa a cikin miya mai ɗanɗano, gasasshen tumatir a hankali, tare da basil sabo da parmesan mai cin ganyayyaki. Ta'aziyya, mai sauƙi, kuma an yi shi don dogon abincin rana.
pasta.ingredients: Rigatoni (alkama), tumatir, Basil, parmesan mai cin ganyayyaki (madara), man zaitun, tafarnuwa.

salad.name: Gasasshen lambun tasa
salad.short: Gasasshen kayan lambu, chickpeas, citrus & ganye.
salad.description: Gasasshen gwoza da dankalin turawa mai daɗi akan ƙwanƙwasa ganye, tare da kajin, citrus mai haske da sabbin ganye. Tufafin lemun tsami ya haɗa duka.
salad.ingredients: Beets, dankalin turawa, chickpeas, citrus, ganye, faski, Mint, sesame, lemun tsami, man zaitun.

chicken.name: Lemon & kajin ganye
chicken.short: Kajin zinari, dankalin jarirai, koren wake.
chicken.description: Ganye-ganye tare da kintsattse fata, ɗan dankalin turawa da koren wake. An yi amfani da shi tare da lemun tsami mai sauƙi da jus-man zaitun.
chicken.ingredients: Kaza, dankali, koren wake, lemo, man zaitun, Rosemary, thyme, tafarnuwa.

cake.name: Chocolate ganache cake
cake.short: Dark cakulan, vanilla cream, sabo ne rasberi.
cake.description: Babban yanki na cakulan Layer cake tare da ganache cakulan duhu mai sheki. Dan kadan vanilla cream da sabo rasberi a gefe.
cake.ingredients: Chocolate, garin alkama, qwai, man shanu (madara), kirim (madara), sukari, vanilla, rasberi.

lemonade.name: Strawberry Basil lemonade
lemonade.short: Fresh strawberry, lemun tsami, Basil & ruwa mai kyalli.
lemonade.description: Lemun tsami mai haske, mai kyalli tare da sabbin strawberries, matsi na lemun tsami da Basil mai kamshi. Bauta kan kankara.
lemonade.ingredients: Strawberry, lemun tsami, Basil, sugar cane, ruwa mai kyalli, kankara.

tea.name: Jasmine ruwan shayi
tea.short: shayin jasmine na fure, lemo, yawan kankara.
tea.description: shayin jasmine da aka yi sabo, a sanyaya kuma a sha kan kankara da lemo. Mara daɗi, tare da ƙarancin fure.
tea.ingredients: Jasmine shayi, lemo, tace ruwa, kankara. Ya ƙunshi maganin kafeyin.
